intro.title: Connect TheTVDB
intro.summary: Adds TV series, season, and episode matches and artwork from TheTVDB.

steps.title: TVDB access
steps.description: TheTVDB issues v4 keys to approved projects, not to individual users of an app.
instructions: Open TheTVDB API information and confirm your project or self-hosted installation has approved access.
If your access is user-supported, obtain your own subscriber PIN for the project key.

steps.title: Enter credentials
steps.description: Enter the approved project API key for this installation. Add your subscriber PIN only when that key requires one. Tuvima does not provide a key or proxy.

steps.title: Verify connection
steps.description: Tuvima will log in directly to TheTVDB using these credentials and store them on this server.

troubleshooting.title: TheTVDB rejected these credentials
troubleshooting.message: Check the project key and, if required, subscriber PIN.
instructions: Confirm the project key is approved for this installation.
Check whether its access model requires a subscriber PIN.

troubleshooting.title: TheTVDB is receiving too many requests
Tuvima could not reach TheTVDB
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: TV seasons and episodes will use another configured provider where available.
